C0716.title: China National Cybersecurity Notification Center Warns of Security Risks in Ollama LLM Tool
C0716.summary: In March 2025, China's National Cybersecurity Notification Center issued a notice on security risks in the Ollama LLM tool, stating that Ollama's default configuration creates risks such as unauthorized access and model theft. The notice said that users privately deploying large models such as DeepSeek without changing default settings may face data leakage, computational resource theft, and service disruption, and recommended limiting listening scope, configuring firewalls, implementing authentication, and patching historical vulnerabilities.
